== Course of events ==

Having recounted her story to Glinda and voiced her greatest wish, to return home to Aunt Em and Uncle Henry in Kansas, Dorothy prepared at last to part from the companions who had traveled with her. The farewell was a tearful one, marking the end of the journey she had shared with them.

Dorothy then clicked her heels together, and at once she was caught up and whirled through the air, carried swiftly back to the Kansas prairie. The flight, however, cost her the Silver Shoes, which were lost along the way, so that when Dorothy arrived back on the Kansas prairie she no longer had them in her possession.
